definitions.gloss: to fulfill one's responsibility; to carry out one's duty
definitions.explanation: To properly discharge an obligation or duty that one has been entrusted with or is expected to carry out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす。
⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たしたい。
examples.english: I want to fulfill my responsibility as a leader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社会的|しゃかいてき}{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たすべきだ。
examples.english: Companies should fulfill their social responsibility.

notes:
A common set phrase combining ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (responsibility) with ⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to fulfill, to carry out). The verb ⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ is the standard collocate for ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ when expressing fulfillment of duty. This phrase reflects the strong emphasis on duty and accountability in Japanese society.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす: to fulfill a responsibility
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす→役割を果たす：19503_yakuwariwohatasu⟧: to fulfill a role
- ⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to fulfill an obligation
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to keep a promise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take responsibility — focuses on accepting blame or consequences, especially for a failure
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to bear responsibility — emphasizes carrying the weight of a duty or burden
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have responsibility — simply states possession of a duty
